description: If a family has fewer indices than cf(a) and all its values are below a, the supremum of their successors is below a.
signature:
Ordinal.iSup_add_one_lt_of_lt_cof.{u} {α : Type u} {f : α → Ordinal.{u}} {a : Ordinal.{u}} (ha : Cardinal.mk α < a.cof)
  (hf : ∀ (i : α), f i < a) : ⨆ i, f i + 1 < a
